title: Intelligent In-Vehicle Scenario Orchestration Agent System
summary: Changan reports that its vehicle agent reduces scenario-configuration tasks from minutes to seconds. Safety and environmental benefits remain unmeasured.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Changan reports that its vehicle agent reduces scenario-configuration tasks from minutes to seconds. Safety and environmental benefits remain unmeasured. In-vehicle agent demonstration / ongoing development. The chapter reports the stated benefit but does not independently verify it.
purpose: Let drivers coordinate vehicle functions through natural-language commands.
developer: Chongqing Changan Automobile, with Ali Cloud collaboration

ratings.reason: The source states that scenario-configuration tasks fall from minutes to seconds. This is a convenience and time-saving claim, without an independently measured user study.
Manufacturers are intended to integrate services more easily; no organizational development gain is measured.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 5: Intelligent In-Vehicle Scenario Orchestration Agent System

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Automotive instruction data and vehicle-service interfaces

headline: Voice commands orchestrate in-vehicle functions

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
